question: Let $S=\{x\in\mathbb R\mid 1\le|x|\le100\}$ be a subset of the real line. Let $M$ be a non-empty subset of $S$ such that for all $x,y$ in $M$, their product $xy$ is also in $M$. Then $M$ can have

options.C: more than 2 but only finitely many elements;
